expanded_prompts.sm-fanged-022-normal-attempt001.txt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one original, gentle fantasy creature for a hand-drawn 2D creature-raising game.
Create exactly ONE new full-body creature, not based on any existing character.
Locked v2 anatomy and materials: Exactly one broad horizontal oval body of continuous width, no narrow waist or body seams. Uniform short velvet-like fur without directional lines. Exactly two round eyes, one gentle closed mouth, exactly four short rounded legs, exactly two short rounded paddle-shaped tails at the rear, both visible and separate. No fangs, teeth, ears, arms or wings.
Locked pose and personality: Keep body horizontal on four distinct feet, tails slightly opened outward, a careful tidy posture, face image-right.
Palette roles primary / secondary / dark accent, respectively: #B8AFCC / #F2E3B8 / #5C6573. Preserve the primary color on the main body, secondary on scales or tufts or soft wings, dark accent for contours and eyes.
Mandatory identifiers: broad seamless oval body without waist; uniform short velvet fur; two short rounded paddle tails.
Style: clear variable-width dark colored outline, restrained three-step cel shading, soft upper-left lighting, modest tactile material cues, appealing proportions. No photorealism or glossy 3D rendering.
Composition: full body, light top-down three-quarter view. Output MUST be exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels RGBA PNG. Center the creature inside the central 80 percent of the square; its longest extent 800–850 pixels and at least 80 completely transparent pixels on each edge. Show all specified appendages distinctly, no cropping.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no drawn checkerboard, no ground, no shadow, no glow. Depict only the creature; no habitat, rocks, leaves, props, clothing, scenery, text, letters, logos, watermarks, frames or extra anatomy.
expanded_prompts.sm-fanged-022-normal-attempt002.txt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image: the new original design-v2 candidate for sm-fanged-022, SHA256 4d1c62a11f4271447c36ce994cf6481244c7a84a810b00c2e16a450f0e11c89e. This request edits only this newly generated friendly creature.
Required targeted quality correction: Remove the large cream scale-like tufts running across the top and back. Replace those protruding tufts with one continuous smooth oval contour covered in UNIFORM short velvet-like fur. The whole body has the same short-pile material, no long tufts, crests, scales, dorsal plates or scalloped patches. Keep exactly two eyes, four legs and the two short rounded paddle tails, plus the existing shape and posture.
Keep all other anatomy, proportions, palette placement, viewing angle, pose and expression the same.
Complete design constraints: Exactly one broad horizontal oval body of continuous width, no narrow waist or body seams. Uniform short velvet-like fur without directional lines. Exactly two round eyes, one gentle closed mouth, exactly four short rounded legs, exactly two short rounded paddle-shaped tails at the rear, both visible and separate. No fangs, teeth, ears, arms or wings.
Palette: #B8AFCC / #F2E3B8 / #5C6573.
Maintain a clean hand-drawn 2D fantasy game illustration with a dark outline and restrained three-step cel shading. Full body, one character, transparent background. Do not add any scene, objects, text or extra body features.
Output must be a 1024 by 1024 RGBA PNG. Center the subject with at least 80 pixels entirely transparent on every edge, its longest extent 800–850 pixels. No cropped parts, ground, shadow, glow, watermark or frames.
expanded_prompts.sm-fanged-022-pixel-attempt001.txt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: one authentic 128x128 pixel-art creature sprite.
Input image is the sole identity reference, sm-fanged-022 design v2, SHA256 b0c2b2e8241300dc472a5e1e390c276a82a01b61c503c601ab282ad851d268a2. Redraw this exact creature as deliberately constructed pixel art. Change only the medium. Do not redesign and do not simply pixelate or downsample the painting.
Locked anatomy and materials: Exactly one broad horizontal oval body of continuous width, no narrow waist or body seams. Uniform short velvet-like fur without directional lines. Exactly two round eyes, one gentle closed mouth, exactly four short rounded legs, exactly two short rounded paddle-shaped tails at the rear, both visible and separate. No fangs, teeth, ears, arms or wings.
Locked pose: Keep body horizontal on four distinct feet, tails slightly opened outward, a careful tidy posture, face image-right. Match the reference's exact proportions, limb placements, silhouette, face, viewing angle and direction.
Locked palette primary/secondary/accent: #B8AFCC / #F2E3B8 / #5C6573. Keep relative color placement.
Identifiers: broad seamless oval body without waist; uniform short velvet fur; two short rounded paddle tails.
Output an exact 128 by 128 RGBA PNG master, not an upscaled preview. Use a true regular 1-pixel grid, thoughtful color clusters, consistent 1–2 pixel outlines and stepped contours. At most 32 opaque RGB colors, alpha exactly 0 or 255, no antialiasing, blur, gradients or semi-transparent pixels. Translate soft textures and translucent membranes into clearly readable opaque color clusters without losing their shape.
Full body centered with longest extent 100–108 pixels and minimum 10 completely transparent pixels on every side. Genuine transparent background. No ground, shadow, glow, background, text, letters, watermark, frame, props, extra anatomy or extra objects. Never add decorative leaves at wing roots or body markings that are not in this reference.
